name: Forplane
definition: A method for reconstructing deformable tissues from monocular or binocular endoscopy videos by factorizing the 4D volume V4d (dimensions H x W x D x T) into a static 3D field Vs3d and a dynamic 3D field Vd3d, both composed of 2D neural planes, to accelerate optimization and inference while maintaining reconstruction quality.
summary: Forplane reconstructs deformable 4D scenes from video by factorizing them into static and dynamic orthogonal neural planes, reducing computational complexity while maintaining high quality.
